children.value: > Fact From Story: Both Rogers-Hixon and Martha Rogers said in documents that they’re still being excluded from some parts of board and committee meetings and are being given redacted board documents.

> > Fact From Story: The two sisters are seeking a judge’s order to force the company to share information with them and allow them to attend, in full, all meetings of the board, as well as board committees they belong to.
> > Fact From Story: “I cannot properly perform my duties as a director if information that is provided to the rest of the directors is being withheld from me,” Rogers-Hixon said in her affidavit.

> > > Fact From Story: The two sisters are seeking a judge’s order to force the company to share information with them and allow them to attend, in full, all meetings of the board, as well as board committees they belong to.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Seeking a judge's order indicates a desire to rectify a perceived wrong or injustice.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Directors need full access to information to perform their duties effectively, and being excluded hinders their ability to do so.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Being excluded from meetings and given redacted documents means not having full access to information and decision-making processes.
